title: Android: Cannot allow keyboard to resize window
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in all?

### System information

Android 13, Moto g 5G (2022)

### Issue description

I need my application to respond to the keyboard being opened. Basically it needs to resize like normal Android applications. Using a node as a spacer only works if the keyboard height is being reported correctly by Godot, which often isn't. It's usually off and doesn't update on keyboard size changes nor rotation changes. 

After some searching, some earlier bug reports were resolved by altering the AndroidManifest in the android path, though this doesn't work anymore and requires some special GD script thing. 

I tried searching that up as well and could find no viable example that shows how it's supposed to be used to alter the `<application>` tag to add additional attributes there. 

I have also tried to use `Engine.get_singleton("AndroidRuntime")` and interface with the Java Android code. While this yields no errors, it also yields no behavior changes. 

```gd
		var runtime = Engine.get_singleton("AndroidRuntime")
		if runtime:
			var activity = runtime.getActivity()
			var testCallable = func():

				# flag SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE
				# https://developer.android.com/reference/android/view/WindowManager.LayoutParams#SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE
				#activity.getWindow().setSoftInputMode(16)
				
				# this should be used because SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE is depricated
				activity.getWindow().setDecorFitsSystemWindows(true)

				var ToastClass = JavaClassWrapper.wrap('android.widget.Toast')
				ToastClass.makeText(activity, 'hello world', ToastClass.LENGTH_LONG).show()
			activity.runOnUiThread(runtime.createRunnableFromGodotCallable(testCallable))
```

Is there an option I'm missing or does someone have an example on how to do this? 

### Steps to reproduce

Create an application with a textbox. Run application on Android and then tap on the textbox to open the builtin keyboard. The application does not resize.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[no_keyboard_resize.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23973448/no_keyboard_resize.zip)
